name: appmixer.siteminder.core.CancelledReservation
label: Cancelled Reservation
description: Triggers when SiteMinder Exchange delivers a cancelled reservation of one of your hotels (status Cancelled). A cancellation can arrive for a reservation that was never delivered before, and then carries little more than the reservation ID and the hotel code. SiteMinder pushes reservations to the reservation endpoint of this connector; the flow receives those of the hotels listed in Hotel Codes when the message carries the endpoint credentials of the connected account.
author: Appmixer <info@appmixer.com>

hotelCodes.label: Hotel Codes
hotelCodes.tooltip: The hotel codes this flow receives reservations for: one code, or several separated by commas or line breaks. A hotel code is the code your application assigned to the property when it was activated in SiteMinder Exchange (HotelCode in the reservation message). A reservation of a hotel that no running flow lists is answered with the error "Hotel not found".
